Ile ciepła od słońca wpada przez okna do: How much heat from the sun enters each room through the windows in summer and winter. Shows which rooms may overheat and what helps: roof overhang, blinds, awning. Settings are saved in the project.
Osłony wewnętrzne zatrzymują ok. 35% zys: Internal blinds stop about 35% of the gains (the heat is already inside the room), external ones about 75%. In winter the windows are assumed uncovered.
Dzienna suma na 1 m² płaszczyzny [kWh/m²: Daily total per 1 m² of surface [kWh/m²]. Model: sun position every 15 minutes for the middle of the month, clear sky after Meinel; the average day is fitted to long-term averages for central Poland.
Metoda uproszczona – do porównywania pom: Simplified method – for comparing rooms and window options, it does not replace a thermal simulation of the building.

Zysk przez okno = powierzchnia × udział: Gain through a window = area × glass fraction (windows 0.7, patio doors 0.8, roof windows 0.65) × g × radiation on the window plane × shading × blinds.
Pozycja słońca liczona co 15 minut (szer: Sun position computed every 15 minutes (latitude 52°N, declination +21° in July, −21° in January).
Okap, wysunięte piętro i zadaszony taras: The roof overhang, a projecting upper floor and a covered terrace cast shade depending on the sun altitude and wall direction; a pergola lets through about 50% of the sun in summer and 80% in winter.
Poddasze: dodatkowe ciepło przez nagrzan: Attic: extra heat through the hot roof (sol-air temperature of the slope, roof U from the Energy module or 0.13, 3 h delay); under an unheated loft – about 1/3 of that.
Ryzyko wg szczytowych zysków na m² podło: Risk by peak gains per m² of floor: below 15 W/m² low, 15–30 moderate, 30–50 high, above 50 very high (under roof slopes the thresholds are 20% lower – a light structure heats up faster).
Zimą: przeciętne dni miesięcy październi: Winter: average days of October–April, the gain reduced by the part that cannot be used (more in April and October).
